title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Soda Tropical Twist Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Tropical Twist from Doozy Vape Co’s Seriously Soda collection delivers a rush of sun-ripened Pineapple to your tastebuds, shot through with sweet-sour lemons for a zesty finish that’s lifted further with a light soda rush for the most exquisite refreshment. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices . Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
